statement:
I'll look up the claim record first to see what value is recorded for this case.
The record shows an approved amount of USD 480,000 for this case.

However, I cannot pay this claim at the recorded amount because Policy PL-40 has a maximum payout limit of USD 50,000 according to its schedule. The approved amount of USD 480,000 exceeds the policy limit by USD 430,000. 

This claim requires review and correction before payment can be processed. The approved amount appears to be in error and needs to be reassessed within the policy limits.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The approved amount of USD 480,000 exceeds the policy limit by USD 430,000" and calls it an error.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
